newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel sees over 100 bln yen profit in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel sees over 100 bln yen profit in 97/98.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp said on Thursday it believed it would be able to post a parent current profit of more than 100 billion yen in the year to March 31 against an estimated parent current profit of 83 billion yen in 1996/97.

"We cannot comment about our profit (forecast) for the 1997/98 business year with confidence at the moment, but we believe we will be able to aim at a parent current profit of more than 100 billion yen by making every possible business effort," a Nippon Steel spokesman said.
